title: Talk is (Not) Cheap: A Taxonomy and Benchmark Coverage Audit for LLM Attacks
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and security aspects of adversarial attacks on LLMs, such as jailbreaking and prompt injection. It audits the coverage of existing benchmarks against a taxonomy of attacks derived from over 900 papers. It does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical reasoning frameworks.
